notes.title: An update to the Qingming Festval version
notes.content:
Wuxing Master has updated to the Qingming version. Here is the details:

1) Added 5 new cards belonging to Yulong.
2) Added 1 new school.
3) Changed the initial character images.
4) Qingming Festval activities would be opend at Apr. 5th.
5) Fixed some BUGs.

Wish you have a good time!
